# Living Résumé

> Living Résumé keeps a résumé current from the user's real build history. One evidence-backed ledger builds a PDF, DOCX, web page, JSON Resume, and a LinkedIn update packet. The user approves every line. It runs inside Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, and as a local MCP server. Zero dependencies, no account, no server.

## Answers
- How do I keep my résumé updated automatically? Install Living Résumé in your AI tool, import LinkedIn or your résumé, and run "check my résumé" monthly. It proposes updates from tagged build moments; you approve them; every format rebuilds.
- Does it invent claims? No. Every public line needs evidence and the user's approval.
- Can it edit LinkedIn? No automated edits (LinkedIn doesn't allow them). It produces a paste-ready packet within LinkedIn's limits.
- How does it stay current? Say "add this to my résumé" in your AI tool. Your AI scores the work against a hiring rubric and proposes a line only if it clears the bar.
- Can I have different versions for different jobs? Yes. Role profiles choose from approved lines only, so every version stays true.
- Pricing: Free (import, inbox and rubric, review, every format, one role profile, publish, small credit link on the web page). Pro, yearly via Polar (unlimited role profiles, job-by-job versions, monthly scout, capability statement, no credit link).
